_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd empyrion/egg-pterodactyl-empyrion--galactic-survival.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) at 8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8. Octail installs the server into the server folder itself instead of an empyrion/ subfolder (so the image's SteamCMD update works: upstream had to keep AUTO_UPDATE off), runs it on its own octail-dedicated.yaml (made once from the shipped dedicated.yaml, which updates overwrite) passed with -dedicated, writes the port, name, password, max players, description, game name, mode, seed, scenario and EAC setting there (yaml parser) before every start, turns telnet off (upstream bridged the console through an unprotected telnet port that other containers on the node network could reach), logs to the console (-logFile -) and detects the start from 'Server started listening on port' or the bound game port (x_octail.features.ready), reserves the three ports the server opens after the game port (Steam query +1, +2, +3, fixed_ports), adds the empyrion tag, the no_console_input flag, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, a branch variable (experimental), stops with Ctrl+C handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1, which ignores it otherwise; upstream stopped through telnet) and waits for it, drops the winetricks verbs (dotnet48 is not needed by the Unity server and takes long to install), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
author: eggs@goover.dev
description: Empyrion - Galactic Survival is a 3D open world space survival game: fly across space, land on planets, build, explore and fight. The Windows dedicated server, run under Wine.

startup_commands.Default: export SteamAppId=383120; wine ./DedicatedServer/EmpyrionDedicated.exe -batchmode -nographics -dedicated octail-dedicated.yaml -logFile - & EMP_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${EMP_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${EMP_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${EMP_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Windows build of the server (it runs under Wine).
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/DedicatedServer/EmpyrionDedicated.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Empyrion dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the server runs on its own config, octail-dedicated.yaml: the game's dedicated.yaml comes with every
## update and would undo the settings. Made once from the shipped one (or a minimal one); Octail sets the
## Startup tab's values in it before every start.
cd /mnt/server
if [[ ! -f octail-dedicated.yaml ]]; then
    if [[ -f dedicated.yaml ]]; then
        cp dedicated.yaml octail-dedicated.yaml
    else
        printf 'ServerConfig:\n    Srv_Port: 30000\n    Srv_Name: Octail Empyrion Server\n    Srv_Password:\n    Srv_MaxPlayers: 8\n    Srv_Public: true\n    Tel_Enabled: false\n    EACActive: true\n    SaveDirectory: Saves\nGameConfig:\n    GameName: DediGame\n    Mode: Survival\n    Seed: 1011345\n    CustomScenario: Default Multiplayer\n' > octail-dedicated.yaml
    fi
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Saves /mnt/server/Logs

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser. Written to octail-dedicated.yaml.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. Empty = no password.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players may be on the server at once.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Shown in the server browser, up to 127 characters; [b]bold[/b] and [url=...]links[/url] work.

variables.name: Game Name
variables.description: The save game (Saves/Games/<name>). A new name starts a new game; the old one stays.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Survival or Creative, for a new game.

variables.name: Seed
variables.description: World generation seed (1 to 7 digits), for a new game.

variables.name: Scenario
variables.description: The scenario a new game starts from: a folder in Content/Scenarios (Default Multiplayer, Default Random, ...) or one you uploaded.

variables.name: Easy Anti-Cheat
variables.description: Players must enable EAC in their options to join a server with it on.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).

variables.name: Windows Install
variables.description: Downloads the Windows build (the server runs under Wine).

variables.name: Branch
variables.description: Optional: a Steam branch such as experimental. Empty = the public release. Reinstall or restart (with Auto Update on) after a change.
